class.name: Box3DRagdollProfile
class.description: [Box3DRagdollProfile] stores per-bone capsule and joint settings for [Box3DRagdoll]. Profiles can be authored directly with dictionary entries in [member bones] or generated with [Box3DRagdollProfileGenerator]. In the editor, the master friction and spring values appear before an editable chain-grouped bone table.

method.name: estimate_bone_mass
method.description: Returns the estimated mass in kilograms for a bone dictionary using the same capsule-volume density model used by [Box3DRagdoll].

method.name: estimate_total_mass
method.description: Returns the estimated total mass in kilograms for all enabled bone entries.

members.member: Optional chain grouping generated by [Box3DRagdollProfileGenerator], keyed by chain name with arrays of bone names.

Array of dictionaries. Each entry uses [code]bone[/code] ([StringName]), [code]enabled[/code], [code]offset[/code] ([Transform3D]), [code]joint_frame[/code] ([Transform3D]), [code]radius[/code], [code]height[/code], [code]density_scale[/code], [code]joint_type[/code], [code]swing_limit[/code], [code]twist_lower[/code], [code]twist_upper[/code], [code]joint_friction_scale[/code], and [code]blend[/code]. [code]offset[/code] places the capsule body relative to the skeleton bone rest pose. [code]joint_frame[/code] is relative to that capsule body; generated profiles set its local X axis to the anatomical bone axis so spherical twist limits and animation-derived limits use the same frame as the runtime joint.
Collision layer assigned to generated ragdoll bodies.
Collision mask assigned to generated ragdoll bodies.
Array of two-name arrays. Each pair creates a native Box3D filter joint that disables collision between those two bone bodies.
Max zero-velocity motor torque used as joint friction.
Spherical joint spring frequency in hertz.
